hints.title: Multi-Delimiter Observation
hints.text: Tokens may contain hyphen delimiters requiring each component word to be capitalized independently.

hints.title: Conditional Case Transformation
hints.text: If a token contains a hyphen, split and capitalize each part around the hyphen; otherwise, capitalize the whole word.

hints.title: Ordered String Aggregation
hints.text: Recombine the formatted word tokens back together separated by single spaces in their original order.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE Words AS (
    SELECT 
        content_id, 
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(content_text, ' ', 1) AS word, 
        SUBSTRING(content_text, LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(content_text, ' ', 1)) + 2) AS remaining_text, 
        1 AS token_index 
    FROM user_content 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT 
        content_id, 
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining_text, ' ', 1) AS word, 
        SUBSTRING(remaining_text, LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining_text, ' ', 1)) + 2) AS remaining_text, 
        token_index + 1 AS token_index 
    FROM Words 
    WHERE remaining_text != ''
), 
Converted AS (
    SELECT 
        content_id, 
        GROUP_CONCAT( 
            IF(word LIKE '%-%', 
                CONCAT(
                    UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)), 
                    LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2, LOCATE('-', word) - 2)), 
                    '-', 
                    UPPER(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(word, '-', -1), 1, 1)), 
                    LOWER(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(word, '-', -1), 2))
                ), 
                CONCAT(UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)), LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))) 
            ) 
            ORDER BY token_index 
            SEPARATOR ' '
        ) AS converted_text 
    FROM Words 
    GROUP BY content_id
) 
SELECT 
    uc.content_id, 
    uc.content_text AS original_text, 
    c.converted_text 
FROM user_content AS uc 
JOIN Converted AS c 
    ON uc.content_id = c.content_id
ORDER BY uc.content_id;
```

complexity.notes: Recursively splits text on space boundaries, handles hyphenated segments, and re-aggregates formatted tokens.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Hyphenated word segments require nested multi-delimiter string casing not handled by standard upper/lower.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(w * l) temporary recursion stack in memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrates conditional recursive tokenization and hyphen handling.
